description:
Read and edit the workspace pronunciation dictionary (Settings → Team → Pronunciation Dictionary). Use it whenever the user asks how a word, name or acronym is said. Do NOT respell the word in the voiceover script instead: the respelling shows in the script and captions, and every new video needs the fix again.

An entry is WORKSPACE-WIDE: it changes the word in every video in this workspace; tell the user when you add or change one. It applies when speech is generated, so regenerate (voiceover_batch generate_speech) the clips that say the word.

action:
  • list   — entries for `language` ("" for all): {entries: [{word, spelling, ipa, language, case_sensitive}], count}
  • set    — add or change `word`'s entry with exactly one of `spelling` (a sound-alike respelling, works on every voice; prefer it) or `ipa` (IPA phonemes, English ElevenLabs voices only, ignored on clips with [audio tags]). An existing entry is not overwritten: you get error "entry_exists" with `current`; show the user both, confirm, then call again with replace: true.
  • remove — delete `word`'s entry in `language` (exact spelling and casing)
  • to_ipa — convert `text` (e.g. a respelling) to IPA, to check an ipa entry before setting it

Editing needs an editor or admin role and a plan with the dictionary; a refusal says which: tell the user, don't retry.

case_sensitive.description: set: match only this exact casing (default false).

language.description: Voice language code or name (default 'en'); an unknown one is an error.

project_id.description: The project being worked on: its open editors pick up the change.

replace.description: set: overwrite an existing entry, only after the user confirmed.

word.description: set/remove: the word as written in the script.

name: pronunciation
title: Pronunciation dictionary
